base_candidate.role: frozen Nautilus execution, costs, account, external pools and current-NAV risk path

prior_failure.diagnosis: V9 removed the V8 latent-state false positives but remained sparse. Its E01 short moved favorably and exited at the transfer-completion protection, yet realized a small net loss because the protection used planned entry and only one extra tick, omitting the frozen two-tick adverse STOP_MARKET fill budget. V10 is an execution-validity correction, not an alpha selection change.

research_question: Does the beta-coherent transfer family preserve its observed alpha when transfer-completion protection is calculated from the actual Nautilus position average fill and remains positive after both fees plus the frozen two-tick adverse STOP_MARKET slippage?

hypothesis.sender_state: Two distinct completed five-minute common-flow events share exactly three sender markets, positive median signed price progress, majority first-origin hold and same-direction aggressor flow.
hypothesis.beta_estimation: For each possible receiver, zero-intercept beta to the median five-minute return of the other three markets is fitted at 24, 48, 96 and 192 bars. Every regression ends strictly before the first evidence event; current-event and future returns are excluded.
hypothesis.confirmation_under_delivery: All four positive beta estimates must imply more directional receiver progress than was observed at the second sender event.
hypothesis.fresh_receiver_leg: The sole excluded market independently forms a post-evidence five-minute MSS, same-direction aggressor-flow displacement, strict FVG and first passive consequent-encroachment retracement.
hypothesis.geometry_under_delivery: At the exact completed MSS bar end, not the following one-minute emission clock, all four fixed betas must still imply more receiver progress than observed.
hypothesis.bounded_displacement: Receiver MSS body must be at least one-half and strictly less than the weakest second-event sender standardized body, distinguishing emerging transfer from noise and independent price discovery.
hypothesis.entry_invalidation_target: Entry, protected swing/opposing-bar stop and next causally live completed-4H or previous-day liquidity target all belong to the new receiver auction leg.
hypothesis.management: After entry, a synchronized completed close reaches the fixed beta-adjusted delivery price or fee-cover activation. The existing STOP_MARKET is then modified from the actual open-position average fill to a trigger that budgets entry maker fee, exit taker fee, two adverse stop-fill ticks and at least one full net tick; the external target is unchanged.
hypothesis.family_isolation: V1-V8 failed families, accepted sender markets, nonpositive/incomplete beta, stale clocks and already consumed completion geometry remain no-trade.
hypothesis.execution_safety: NautilusTrader exclusively owns orders, fills, fees, positions and NAV. Cost-cover uses the unique open Position.avg_px_open; a missing/non-unique position or live parent-entry remainder fails closed. The four instruments share one global pending-entry-or-position slot and current-NAV planned loss remains 3%.

selection.method: E01-E06 are the fully exposed V4-V9 mechanism-development intervals. V10 reuses them solely to verify an execution-validity correction against the observed E01 protection defect; no success claim is permitted.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and can only reject or verify the V10 mechanism and execution correction.
V10 changes only transfer-completion protection accounting; beta state selection, entries, invalidation, target, risk and global slot remain frozen from V9.
Every protection trigger must be derived from the unique actual open-position average fill and remain at least one tick profitable after both fees and two adverse STOP_MARKET ticks.
Passing development permits source freeze and newly predeclared untouched confirmation only.

Success requires a frozen continuous Nautilus account with realistic costs, sufficient independent opportunities, no liquidation or unrecoverable damage, and project-level daily geometric growth of at least 1%.
